name: dk-brain-arena
description: DK BRAIN ARENA — 공통 플랫폼과 게임별 독립 배포 구조 1차 구현

scripts.emulators: node scripts/build.mjs all && firebase emulators:start --project demo-dk-brain-arena
scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/build.mjs all && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dk-brain-arena "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs all && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dk-brain-arena "node tests/e2e-browser.mjs"
scripts.test:reconnect: node scripts/build.mjs all && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dk-brain-arena "node tests/e2e-reconnect.mjs"
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:rules && npm run check:functions-bundle && npm run check:dist && npm run test:offline && npm run test:emulator && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:reconnect
